unit: U10 (data-server.md rev 2) — keys used by lib/drive/errors.ts, the DocEditorRoute file-type / not-found states and the owner-only permission lock
note: Copy to scripts/i18n/drive/data-layer.json. Terminology follows drive-disclosure.json: My files = 我的文件/我的檔案, Store files = 门店文件/店面檔案/店舖檔案. drive.errors.notConnected is NOT a key: not_connected maps to the existing toast.notConnected. Rev 2: drive.errors absorbs storage-api's extra codes (integration-legal §14.2; DS wording wins on duplicates; storage 'unknown' maps to drive.errors.generic, not a key); notPending folded into conflict; docs.errors.locked/leaseRequired removed (sheet errors are sheets.*). CONTRACTS.md §6: client codes map to keys through DRIVE_ERROR_I18N_KEYS — not_configured → drive.errors.storageUnavailable (copy reworded: platform config, not the store owner), network → drive.errors.offline, aborted → drive.upload.canceled (drive-ui), orphan_brake/unknown → drive.errors.generic. Copied into the repo by W0.7.
